note: P0-01 CI Truth Repair: required-command groups for the fail-fast group runner (scripts/ci/failfast_group.py). Each group runs strictly in sequence without a shell; the first non-zero command stops the group and its exit code becomes the group (and step) exit code, so a later successful command can never mask an earlier failure. Paths are repository-root relative; working_dir is relative to the repo root. Group env values may be module-relative path lists (e.g. PYTHONPATH 'src:scripts'); the runner expands relative segments against the group working_dir into absolute paths, so a step's working directory can never drift the environment.
